## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: flat risk ratios (VIX neutral; SPY_TLT neutral) and weak breadth (Energy/Utilities/Industrials only); VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising shows short-term volatility pick-up.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity/energy surge: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND driving cyclical reflation. Credit and rates neutral: HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND → flat and LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) ↓ falling against TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) ↓ falling, leaving SPY/TLT effectively neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; Utilities and Industrials also positive (sector breadth). Tech mixed: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) → flat and XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) → flat; style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%). EM/China patchy: EEM RECOVERY (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) → flat and FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) → flat.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Muted: ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%) BELOW TREND show limited small-cap/speculative risk-taking, while IBIT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) ABOVE TREND shows selective crypto strength.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND leading; CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND confirms industrial reflation.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership intact: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) ↑ rising but 1M weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy/commodities strength across timeframes (XLE, BNO, USO ABOVE TREND). Major divergence across core ETFs (SPY CORRECTION, XLK RECOVERY, XLF CORRECTION) constitutes MAJOR Divergence and suppresses strong regime calls.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor energy/commodity exposure (XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit; reduce exposure to broad tech risk (QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND; XLK RECOVERY) given mixed breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials (sector breadth +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND and Communication sector (-4.40% | 1M: -3.77%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -6.59%) RECOVERY remain vulnerable on 1M weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 as volatility breakpoint (VXX RECOVERY 1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%). HYG/LQD cross for credit health with HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%). XLE strength threshold to confirm cyclical leadership: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, flat risk ratios and weak breadth keep the market balanced. Energy/commodities showing clear strength while major divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF is the key risk to monitor.
